description: This file defines a React component called TemplateSelect, which provides a minimal user interface for selecting between two types of Statement of Work (SOW): Fixed Price and Time & Materials. It includes no external dependencies beyond React and exports the component as default.

methods.name: TemplateSelect({ selected, onChange })
methods.description: A React functional component that renders two buttons allowing users to select between 'Fixed Price' and 'Time & Materials' SOW types. It accepts 'selected' and 'onChange' props to manage and handle the selection.
